title: QR code phishing in practice
intro: Check the address before you open. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Café menu QR code

artifact.title: Chinar Tea House. Menu
body: You scanned a QR code: Chinar Tea House. Menu

decisions.explain: The domain matches the cafe's name and the page only shows a menu. Nothing is requested.

decisions.title: Sticker on a parking meter

artifact.title: Parking meter. You have a fine, scan and pay
body: You scanned a QR code: Parking meter. You have a fine, scan and pay

decisions.explain: Fines are not collected through stickers. Check fines only on the official portal or app.

decisions.title: QR code in an e-mail

artifact.title: Your account verification expires. Scan to renew
body: You scanned a QR code: Your account verification expires. Scan to renew

decisions.explain: An email with a QR code to verify your account is a classic trap. Open the portal yourself from a bookmark.

decisions.title: Free Wi-Fi QR code

artifact.title: Free Wi-Fi. Scan to connect
body: You scanned a QR code: Free Wi-Fi. Scan to connect

decisions.explain: Free internet never needs your card. An unknown domain plus a card request is a trap.

decisions.title: Donation QR code

artifact.title: Help children. Scan to donate
body: You scanned a QR code: Help children. Scan to donate

decisions.explain: A shortened link hides the real address. Donate only on the charity's official website.
